summary: Page ki reels aur long videos dono hi achi chal rahi hain, lekin tawakkul, Quran ki ayat ki tafseer aur amanah jaisay topics sab se zyada views aur engagement la rahe hain. Jo videos value of salah, anger control ya generic prophet stories hain, unka performance bahut kam hai aur unko kam ya nayaab banaya jana chahiye. In insights ko use karke aapko content ko in high‑scoring themes aur hooks ke sath focus karna chahiye taake views, shares aur followers barhein.

tips: Focus on high‑performing themes like "trusting Allah (tawakkul)", "reflection on a Quran verse" and "honesty & trust (amanah)"; use Reel format (short 30‑60 sec) for these topics as they have the highest x‑scores
Avoid low‑scoring themes such as "value of salah", "controlling anger" and generic prophet lessons; replace them with the top‑scoring themes
Start each video with a strong hook: a surprising fact or question related to the Quran verse or miracle, then tell the story in a concise narrative and end with a clear call‑to‑action (share/like)

Use titles that highlight the benefit or miracle, e.g., "Aayat al‑Kursi ka Asar" or "Badr ki Jeet ka Raaz" and keep them under 8 words for reels; long videos can be up to 3‑4 minutes but keep the intro under 15 seconds
